text:
Jenna: Short sync  pricing page playtest items: final tier labels, FAQ bullets, calculator defaults, and webinar signup routing. Need decisions by EOD so design can finish mocks.

Miguel: Tier names I like: Launch / Growth / Enterprise. They map to intent and sound clear in CTA.

Hana: UX: default the calculator to 'Estimated monthly spend (USD)' but display a small inline toggle 'show per-1k price'. Add micro-tooltips on each metric (tokens/request, calls/day).

Pri: FAQ drafts (very short):
1) "How is usage billed?" -> billed per 1k tokens, see docs.
2) "Can I bring my model?" -> yes, via Dedicated/Private.
3) "What uptime can I expect?" -> per-tier SLA summary.
4) "Can I change plans mid-cycle?" -> upgrades prorated.
5) "How do I estimate costs?" -> use the calculator.
6) "Do you offer discounts?" -> contact sales.

Samir: Webinar gating rule suggestion: on webinar signup capture calc_est_monthly and company_size. If calc_est_monthly >= 1800 OR company_size >= 50 -> tag as "pricing_high" and route to AE queue; else nurture. This catches both spend and org-size intent.

Miguel: For benchmark narrative, include a small example: "Customer A: chat assistant ~3k tokens/day -> Launch: $X/mo, Growth: $Y/mo, Enterprise: $Z/mo; p95 latency: 80ms/60ms/40ms". Helps map use-case to dollars/latency.

Hana: A/B test ideas: Variant 1 shows monthly estimate prominently; Variant 2 shows cost-per-1k prominently. Metric: demo requests and trial signups. We'll surface experiment flags: pricing_metric_primary / pricing_label_set_launch.

DesignBot: Feature flags created: pricing_metric_primary, pricing_label_set_launch.

Pri: Tiny copy tweak: label should read "Estimated monthly spend (USD)" not just "Estimated monthly". Also add footer: "Estimate based on your inputs."

Jenna: Timeline: copy freeze by tomorrow noon, design final by Wed, front-end flag rollout Thu, QA Fri. Webinar + launch post scheduled for next Mon.

Samir: I'll implement routing flow and share SFDC export. Also recommend adding GA events: pricing_calc_submit, webinar_signup_pricing.

Miguel: I'll craft the benchmark snippet and three headline variants and drop them here by 4pm.

Hana: UX will hand off two mock variants (monthly-first, per-1k-first) for QA.

Jenna: Great. If no objections to the routing rule (1800 or company_size >=50) we'll proceed. Ping me if you see issues. :rocket:
